summary: MINISO Group Holding Ltd filed a Form 6-K with Exhibit 99.1, a Monthly Return of Equity Issuer on Movements in Securities for July 2026, submitted to the Hong Kong Exchanges and Clearing Limited. The filing reports no changes in authorized or issued share capital during the month: authorized shares remained at 10,000,000,000 with issued shares at 1,238,960,393, and no treasury shares. It includes a public float sufficiency confirmation and details on outstanding share options under the 2020 Share Incentive Plan, with no options exercised. This is a routine regulatory monthly disclosure, not a special situation.
